articles.title: Watch: Palestinian killed in Israeli strike on vehicle in Gaza City
articles.summary: An Israeli air strike on a vehicle in Gaza City’s Tel al-Hawa neighbourhood killed at least one Palestinian and wounded others. Another Israeli strike killed one Palestinian in Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, a source at Al-Awda Hospital told Al Jazeera. Israeli forces also shot and killed a teenage girl in the al-Faluja area of northern Gaza, shooting her in the head. articles.title: Israeli drone strikes kill one Palestinian and wound 13 in Gaza
articles.summary: An Israeli drone strike killed one Palestinian in Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, a source at Al-Awda Hospital told Al Jazeera. Another drone strike wounded 13 Palestinians in northern Gaza City, the Palestine Red Crescent said. A drone attack on al-Shifa Street in western Gaza City also caused injuries.
